anomalies.observed: On the SkylabModule sheet the EPD high-side P-MOS switch Q2 (NTR2101P) is shown with a 1 µF/25 V capacitor C14 wired into its gate/source node and that node tied directly to +3V3; there is no 10 kΩ pull-up resistor R2 anywhere on the schematic, and the gate is not shown connected to U5.31 (P4_LED).
anomalies.expected: The spec requires the gate pull-up R2 = 10 kΩ from gate to +3V3 (gate defaults high/off) with the gate also driven by SKW92A pin 31 (U5.31), and Q2's source hard-tied to +3V3, so the GPIO can switch the EPD rail on/off. A capacitor cannot act as a pull-up.

evidence.quote: §3: "+3V3 rail destinations: ... and the gate pull-up R2 (10 kΩ, pulling Q2's gate high/off by default)"
§4: "Net-(Q2-G) = Q2.1 (gate), R2.1→R2.2→+3V3 (10 kΩ pull-up, gate defaults high/off), and U5.31 (SKW92A GPIO ...)"
SkylabModule.kicad_sch (page 1/4): Q2 NTR2101P with C14 1uF/25V at the gate/+3V3 node; no R2 present on any sheet

anomalies.impact: The P-channel high-side switch is stuck with Vgs≈0 (gate tied to +3V3, no GPIO drive, no pull-up), so Display_Power_Switch never energizes and the e-paper panel receives no VDD/VDDIO; alternatively, with the pull-up missing the gate floats and the documented 'Display Power MOSFET heats up while off' regression returns.

anomalies.observed: On the EPD_Driver sheet the boost-converter input capacitor C1 is drawn as 0.1 µF / 16 V.
anomalies.expected: The spec's component-matching table lists Meshinger C1 in the 1 µF / 25 V group (PDI 'C2 default'), i.e. C1 should be 1 µF/25 V, matching the G1-group reference design.

evidence.quote: §4 table: "C2 default: 1 µF/25 V | C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 µF/25 V | Matches default"
EPD_Driver.kicad_sch (page 1/4): C1 0.1uF/16V on the Display_Power_Switch/L1 node

anomalies.impact: Reduced input decoupling on the EPD boost rail (0.1 µF instead of 1 µF) can destabilize the charge-pump/boost converter and degrade display refresh.

parsed.summary: The build deviates from the intended design at the EPD power switch: the 10 kΩ gate pull-up R2 is absent and a 1 µF capacitor (C14) sits in the Q2 gate/+3V3 node with no U5.31 drive, leaving the high-side e-paper power switch non-functional; a secondary value mismatch appears on EPD input cap C1 (0.1 µF vs the specified 1 µF).
